title: Identify thirty European queued transfer resources
platforms: European ROM; Wine disassembly and static source plan
changes: Establish the original selector and source contract for thirty localized queued transfer resources across all five language banks.
validation: Wine disassembly a3h2cux_ and protected source plan it7ywjrs authenticate the 30 pointers, sizes, payloads, reader instructions and existing queue helper, totaling 6008 previously unowned bytes.
limitations: Managed extraction and runtime consumption, ordinary invocation, unrestricted guest indices, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
